basic_info.description: Welcome to 3046-3048 Polk Streeta rare, fully VACANT 3-unit building nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Overlooking the open green space of Galileo High School's sports field, this charming property blends timeless period details with modern updates and offers incredible flexibility for both owner-occupiers and savvy investors.  The top-floor residence is a spacious 4BD/2BA unit, recently refreshed with new paint, refinished hardwood floors, updated kitchen and baths, and new vinyl flooring in key areas. A private patio and in-unit washer/dryer add to the comfort and livability.  Downstairs, you'll find two well-appointed 1BD/1BA units with hardwood floors and updated kitchens and bathroomsperfect for rental income or extended family. A shared rear patio provides space for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing.  A rare 3-car garage spans the length of the building, offering abundant parking and storage.  With the same family for decades, this well-maintained building is now being sold by a successor trustee and is not subject to court confirmation.  Just steps from the vibrant Van Ness corridor and blocks to Polk Street, Ghirardelli Square, Maritime Park, Fort Mason, Francisco Park, Fisherman's Wharf, and the iconic Cable Car line.
